x-m-h2-01.title: Hel sadarka halkaas oo xalka isla'egta logarithm-ku uu dhibaato leeyahay
x-m-h2-01.goal: Hel oo saxo dhibaatada ka timid iyadoo aan la hubin shuruudda dood-qiimaha ee xalka isla'egta logarithm.
x-m-h2-01.material: Minho wuxuu xallay isla'egta log₂(x−1) + log₂(x−3) = 3 wuxuuna jawaabay, 'Xalalku waa x=5 iyo x=−1, laba.' Sida loo akhriyo, waa 'log salka 2 ee (x laga jaray 1) ku dar log salka 2 ee (x laga jaray 3) waxay le'eg tahay 3'.
x-m-h2-01.thinking.0: Hubi sadar kasta oo xalka ah
x-m-h2-01.prereq.0: Macnaha iyo sifooyinka aasaasiga ah ee logarithm-yada
x-m-h2-01.s.s1.prompt: Dooro sadarka xalka Minho ee dhibaatada leh. (Haddii dhowr sadar oo isku xigta ay dhibaato yihiin, waxaad dooran kartaa hal oo keliya.)
x-m-h2-01.s.s1.hint.0: Mar kasta oo tibaaxdu is beddesho, akhri adigoo hubinaya inay la macno tahay sadarkii hore.
x-m-h2-01.s.s1.hint.1: Qiimayaasha dhammaadka xalka toos u geli isla'egta sadarka koowaad. Maxaa ku dhaca qiimaha logarithm-ka dhexdiisa?
x-m-h2-01.s.s1.line.5: Sidaa darteed xalalku waa x = 5 iyo x = −1, laba.
x-m-h2-01.s.s1.explain: Meesha ugu horreysa ee uu ka goostay waa sadarka 2. Marka isugeynta labada logarithm lagu mideeyo hal logarithm, shuruudaha dood-qiimaha x−1>0 iyo x−3>0 way ka lumaan tibaaxda, shuruudahaas na si gooni ah looma qorin. Sidaa darteed sadarka 5 labada xidid waa la aqbalay, sadarka 6 na waa gunaanadkaas. Dood-qiimuhu waa inuu noqdaa togan, sidaa darteed x>3 ayaa loo baahan yahay. Haddii x=−1, markaas x−1=−2 iyo x−3=−4, dood-qiimayaashu waa taban yihiin, sidaa darteed isla'egtu ma qeexna. Haddii x=5, log₂4 + log₂2 = 2+1 = 3, sidaa darteed way run tahay. Sidaa darteed xalku waa hal qiime oo keliya x=5.
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.prompt: U sheeg Minho xalka saxda ah iyo sababta. Ku dar dhibaatada dhacda marka x=−1 la geliyo isla'egta asalka ah.
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.hint.0: Akhri adigoo hubinaya sababta tibaaxda loo beddelay sadar kasta.
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.hint.1: Geli x=−1 iyo x=5 mid mid dood-qiimayaasha logarithm-yada isla'egta asalka ah oo hubi qiimayaasha noqda.
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma sharaxday sababta x=−1 xal u noqon karin adigoo isticmaalaya qiimaha dood-qiimaha?
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma sheegtay shuruudda loo baahnaa ka hor inta aan tibaaxda la beddelin?
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma gelisay x=5 isla'egta asalka ah si aad u hubiso inay buuxiso?
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.model.0: Xalka keliya waa x=5. Haddii aan geliyo x=−1, dood-qiimuhu waa taban sida log₂(−2), sidaa darteed ma qeexna. Sidaa darteed kaliya 5, oo buuxisa shuruudda dood-qiimaha x>3, ayaa xal ah.
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.model.1: Marka isla'egta la xallinayo, dood-qiimayaashu waa inay had iyo jeer noqdaan togan. x−1>0 iyo x−3>0, sidaa darteed x>3 ayaa loo baahan yahay, x=−1 na ma ku jiro xadkan, sidaa darteed waa in la tuuro. Sidaa darteed jawaabtu waa x=5.
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.model.2: Shuruudaha dood-qiimaha x−1>0 iyo x−3>0, x>3. x=−1 waa ka baxsan xadka, sidaa darteed ka tuur, jawaabtuna waa 5.
x-m-h2-01.s.s2.model.3: Jawaabtu waa 5. Geliinta x=−1 waxay siinaysaa log₂(−2), taasoo aan la qeexin, sidaa darteed xal ma aha.

x-m-h2-06.s.s3.prompt: Sₙ = p·n² + q·n + r (p, q, r waa tirooyin dhan, p≠0), hel saddex (p, q, r) oo kala duwan oo qiimaha aad ka hesho gelinta n=1 qaacidada laga helay n≥2 ay la mid tahay a₁, si eraygii guud loo qori karo sidii hal qaacido.
x-m-h2-06.s.s3.hint.0: Sₙ=pn²+qn+r, qor Sₙ−Sₙ₋₁ n≥2 marka loo eego p iyo q.
x-m-h2-06.s.s3.hint.1: Barbar dhig qiimaha aad ka hesho gelinta n=1 qaacidadaas iyo S₁=p+q+r.
x-m-h2-06.s.s3.ok.c1: p waa tiro dhan oo aan ahayn 0.
x-m-h2-06.s.s3.fail.c1: p, q, r waa tirooyin dhan, p-na waa inaysan noqon 0.
x-m-h2-06.s.s3.ok.c2: Qiimaha qaacidada laga helay n≥2 marka n=1 waxay la mid tahay a₁=S₁.
x-m-h2-06.s.s3.fail.c2: Qiimaha p+q ee qaacidada p(2n−1)+q ee laga helay n≥2 marka n=1 ma la mid aha S₁=p+q+r.
x-m-h2-06.s.s3.explain: n≥2, aₙ=Sₙ−Sₙ₋₁=p(2n−1)+q, sidaas darteed gelinta n=1 waxay siinaysaa p+q. a₁=S₁=p+q+r, sidaas darteed waxay siman yihiin marka r=0 oo keliya. Sₙ=n²+2n+1 wuxuu leeyahay r=1, sidaas darteed eraygii koowaad waa in si gooni gooni ah loo maareeyo.

x-m-h2-07.title: Ma ∞−∞ waxay le'eg tahay 0? Hubinta labada sheegasho ee saaxiibada
x-m-h2-07.goal: Tijaabi labada sheegasho adigoo isticmaalaya xisaab tiro ah, sharax halka sababaynta dareenka ku khaldantay, ka dibna hel xadka adigoo isticmaalaya aljebra.
x-m-h2-07.material: Minsu wuxuu yiri, ‘Marka x uu aan dhammaad lahayn weynaado, √(x²+x) wuxuu u dhowaadaa x, sidaas darteed √(x²+x) − x wuxuu u dhowaadaa 0.’ Seoa wuxuu yiri, ‘Ma u dhowaado 0, wuxuu u dhowaadaa lambar togan oo gaar ah.’ Sida loo akhriyo: √(x²+x) waa xididka x laba-jibbaaran oo lagu daray x, ‘x wuxuu aan dhammaad lahayn weynaadaa’-na waa x→∞.
x-m-h2-07.prereq.0: Macnaha xad marka x uu aan dhammaad lahayn weynaado
x-m-h2-07.s.s1.prompt: Waxaad isticmaali kartaa xisaabiye. Dooro saddex tiro dhan oo x ah oo ugu yaraan 100, xisaabi qiimaha √(x²+x) − x, ku wareeji saddex meel oo tobanle ah, oo geli sidii (x, qiime). Gelinta saddex x oo kala duwan waxay dhammaystirtaa. (Haddii sheegashada Minsu sax tahay, qiimahani waa inuu u sii dhowaado 0 marka x weynaado.)
x-m-h2-07.s.s1.hint.0: Geli x=100 iyo x=1000 √(x²+x)−x oo xisaabi.
x-m-h2-07.s.s1.hint.1: Ka dhig x mid ka weyn oo eeg jihada uu qiimuhu u dhaqaaqo.
x-m-h2-07.s.s1.ok.c1: x waa tiro dhan oo ugu yaraan 100.
x-m-h2-07.s.s1.fail.c1: x waa inuu noqdaa tiro dhan oo ugu yaraan 100.
x-m-h2-07.s.s1.ok.c2: Qiimaha aad gelisay wuxuu waafaqsan yahay natiijada la xisaabiyay ee √(x²+x)−x.
x-m-h2-07.s.s1.fail.c2: Qiimaha aad gelisay wuu ka duwan yahay natiijada la xisaabiyay. Mar kale xisaabi √(x²+x)−x adigoo isticmaalaya xisaabiye oo u soo koob saddex meel oo tobanle.
x-m-h2-07.s.s1.explain: x=100 waa ku dhawaad 0.4988, x=1000 ku dhawaad 0.49988, x=10000 ku dhawaad 0.49999. Xitaa haddii aad x ka dhigto mid weyn, ma u dhowaado 0 oo wuxuu ku sii jiraa ku dhawaad 0.5.
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.prompt: Marka la eego natiijooyinka xisaabinta, odhaahda Minsu iyo Seoa kee ayaa si fiican loo taageeray? Dooro sharraxaadda ugu sax ah.
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.hint.0: Dhig qiimayaasha lagu xisaabiyay saddexda qiime ee x isku xigta oo arag sida qiimuhu u is beddelo marka x weynaado.
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.hint.1: Kala sooc haddii ‘u dhowaanshuhu’ ku saabsan yahay saami ama farqi.
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.o.a: Odhaahda Seoa waa la taageeray. Farqigu wuxuu ku ururaa qiime aan ahayn 0
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.r.a: Xitaa marka x la weyneeyay, qiimuhu ma is beddelin 0.5 agtiisa, sidaas darteed waa caddayn ka dhan ah sheegashada ah inuu yahay 0.
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.o.b: Minsu waa sax. Saamigu wuxuu u dhowaadaa 1, sidaas darteed farqigu sidoo kale wuxuu u dhowaadaa 0
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.r.b: Saamiga u dhowaanshaha 1 macnaheedu ma aha farqiga u dhowaanshaha 0. Tusaale ahaan, saamiga x iyo x+0.5 wuxuu u dhowaadaa 1, laakiin farqigu had iyo jeer waa 0.5.
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.o.c: Minsu waa sax. Qiimaha ka weyn 0 waa qalad xisaabiye
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.r.c: Marka aad beddesho x oo qiimayaashu ku ururaan isla qiime (0.5 agtiisa), way adag tahay in loo aqoonsado qalad.
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.o.d: Midna ma sheegi kartid. Xisaabintu wax kuma sheegi karto
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.r.d: Tirooyinku xadka ma caddeeyaan, laakiin waa caddayn ka dhan ah sheegashada ‘0’.
x-m-h2-07.s.s2.explain: Qiimayaasha la xisaabiyay waxay ku ururaan 0.5 agtiisa xitaa marka x weynaado, sidaas darteed odhaahda Seoa waa la taageeray. Laakiin tirooyinku waa caddayn oo keliya, si loo hubiyo qiimaha saxda ah, waa inaad beddeshaa tibaaxda.
x-m-h2-07.s.s3.prompt: Qor sababta sababaynta Minsu ‘√(x²+x) wuxuu u dhowaadaa x, sidaas darteed farqigu waa 0’ u khaldan tahay, oo hel qiimaha xadka adigoo beddelaya tibaaxda.
x-m-h2-07.s.s3.hint.0: Qor waxa korreeyuhu noqdo marka aad √(x²+x)−x ku dhufato oo aad u qaybiso √(x²+x)+x.
x-m-h2-07.s.s3.hint.1: Korreeyaha iyo hooseeyaha ku qaybi x, kadibna arag qiime kasta qayb u dhowaado marka x aad u weynaado dhammaad la'aan.
x-m-h2-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma kala saartay laba qiime oo is u dhowaada iyo farqiga labada qiime oo noqonaya 0?
x-m-h2-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Beddelidda aad samaysay ma ka dhigtay tibaaxda qaab xadka lagu heli karo?
x-m-h2-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Qiimaha aad ku aragtay xisaabinta (0.4999…) iyo xadka aad heshay ma waafaqsan yihiin?
x-m-h2-07.s.s3.model.0: U dhowaanshaha x macnaheedu waa saamigu wuxuu u dhowaadaa 1, ma aha in farqigu noqdo 0. Rationalizing korreeyaha waxay siinaysaa x/(√(x²+x)+x)=1/(√(1+1/x)+1), marka x→∞ waa 1/2.
x-m-h2-07.s.s3.model.1: Xitaa haddii √(x²+x) u eg yahay x, weli farqi ayaa u dhexeeya labada tiro, sidaas darteed waa inaanan u beddelin x−x=0. Ku dhufashada korreeyaha iyo hooseeyaha isku-xigga √(x²+x)+x waxay siinaysaa x/(√(x²+x)+x), xadkuna waa 0.5 (=1/2).

x-m-h2-08.title: Laga bilaabo xawaaraha celceliska ilaa xawaaraha degdegga ah
x-m-h2-08.goal: Yaree inta u dhexeysa, arag qiimaha xawaaraha celceliska u dhowaado, oo naftaada u habee macnaha xawaaraha degdegga ah.

Laakiin xawaaruhu waa (masaafada la socday)÷(waqtiga la qaaday), ‘daqiiqad’ ahaanna waqtiga la qaaday waa 0, sidaas darteed waxay u egtahay inaadan qaybin karin.
x-m-h2-08.thinking.2: Habee macnaha heerka isbeddelka degdegga ah
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.prompt: Xogta waxaa la muujiyaa hal qayb mar. Tallaabo kasta, dooro xukun.
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.hint.0: Qor dhererka inta u dhexeysa iyo xawaaraha celceliska isku xigta xogta la muujiyay.
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.hint.1: Barbar dhig haddii saadaashaada iyo qiimaha cusub ay isku waafaqaan, haddii kale ka fikir waxa aad seegtay.

x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.0.after: Haddii inta u dhexeysa ay dheer tahay, xawaaruhu wuu is beddelaa intaas gudaheeda, sidaas darteed xawaaraha celceliska wuu ka duwan yahay xawaaraha hal daqiiqad. Aan yareyno inta u dhexeysa.
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Waa 4 m/s. Xawaaraha celceliska waa xawaaraha daqiiqaddaas
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Haddii xawaaruhu is beddelo inta u dhexeysa, ma odhan kartid xawaaraha celceliska wuxuu la mid yahay xawaaraha daqiiqadda bilowga.
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Weli ma odhan karo. Waxaan u baahanahay inaan helo xawaaraha celceliska inta u dhexeysa oo gaaban oo laga bilaabo 1 ilbiriqsi sidoo kale
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Halkii aad hal daqiiqad ku go'aamin lahayd hal celcelis oo inta dheer ah, waxaad isku daydaa inaad ku hubiso inta u dhexeysa oo cidhiidhi ah.
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ma ogaan karo. Daqiiqad, waqtigu waa 0, sidaas darteed xawaaraha lama qeexi karo
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Isla markiiba ma qaybin kartid inta u dhexeysa waqti 0, laakiin waxaa jira hab lagu u dhowaado inta gaaban.
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.1.info: Xawaaraha celceliska inta u dhexeysa [1, 2] waa 3, [1, 1.5] waa (2.25−1)÷0.5 = 2.5, [1, 1.1] na waa (1.21−1)÷0.1 = 2.1 m/s.
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.1.ask: Haddii aad inta u dhexeysa sii yarayso, sida [1, 1.01], [1, 1.001], maxaa ku dhaca xawaaraha celceliska?
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.1.after: [1, 1.01] wuxuu siinayaa (1.0201−1)÷0.01 = 2.01, [1, 1.001] na wuxuu siinayaa 2.001. Korreeyaha iyo hooseeyaha labaduba waxay u dhowaadaan 0, laakiin saamigu wuxuu u ururaa 2.
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Wuxuu u dhowaadaa 0. Sababtoo ah dhererka inta u dhexeysa wuxuu u dhowaadaa 0
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Waxaad eegtay dhererka inta u dhexeysa oo keliya. Masaafada la socday sidoo kale waa yaraataa, sidaas darteed waa inaad eegtaa saamiga.
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Intii ay ka yaraanaysay [1, 1.5] ilaa [1, 1.1], waxay sii dhacaysay 2.5 ilaa 2.1.
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Waxaad qiyaastay qiimaha uu ku ururo iyadoo laga soo bilaabo jihada hoos u dhaca ee xawaaraha celceliska: 3, 2.5, 2.1.

x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.2.ask: Marka h aad u dhowaado 0 dhammaad la'aan iyadoo aan ahayn 0, sidee ayay ku habboon tahay in lagu qeexo xawaaraha degdegga ah ee t=1 ilbiriqsi?
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.2.after: Xawaaraha degdegga ah waa qiimaha 2 ee xawaaraha celceliska 2+h u dhowaado marka h→0. Qiimahan waxaa loo yaqaan kala-duwaha t=1.
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Waa 2+h. Wuxuu ku xidhan yahay h
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.2.r.a: h waa dhererka inta u dhexeysa, xawaaraha degdegga ahna waa hal qiime oo la u dhowaado marka inta u dhexeysa yaraato.

x-m-h2-08.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Halkii aad geli lahayd h=0, waxaad u qaadatay sida xawaaraha degdegga ah meesha qiimuhu u dhowaado intii h u dhowaanayso 0.
x-m-h2-08.s.s1.reflect: Bilowga waxaad u malaysay xawaaraha celceliska 4 ee inta dheer sida xawaaraha degdegga ah, laakiin marka aad xogta ku aragtay inta u dhexeysa oo la yareeyay qiimuhu ku ururo 2, waxaad dib u eegtay xukunkaaga. x-m-h2-08.s.s2.hint.1: Qor sida dhererka inta aad xisaabisay xawaaraha celceliska ay u is beddeshay.
x-m-h2-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma qortay xukunkii ugu horreeyay (4) iyo kii dambe (2) adigoo barbar dhigaya?
x-m-h2-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma isticmaashay qiimayaasha xawaaraha celceliska (2.5, 2.1, iwm.) sida caddayn?

x-m-h2-09.material: Arday ayaa yidhi, ‘Shaqada saddex-jibbaarka ah f(x)=x³+ax²+bx, haddii c jiro oo f'(c)=0, markaas had iyo jeer wuxuu leeyahay extremum (ugu badnaan meel ama ugu yaraan meel) x=c.’ (f' waa kala-duwaha f, f'(x)=3x²+2ax+b. Extremum waa qiimaha shaqada barta ay ka beddesho kordhid ilaa hoos u dhac, ama hoos u dhac ilaa kordhid.)
x-m-h2-09.thinking.1: Xukun haddii shuruuddu ku filan tahay
x-m-h2-09.prereq.0: Macnaha kala-duwaha iyo kala-duwidda shaqooyinka polynomial
x-m-h2-09.prereq.1: Kordhidda iyo hoos u dhaca shaqooyinka
x-m-h2-09.s.s1.prompt: Hel saddex lammaane oo kala duwan oo tirooyin dhan a, b oo f leeyahay c oo f'(c)=0 laakiin extremum ma leh (ma hoos u dhaco inta u dhexeysa), si aad u samayso tusaalayaal lid ku ah.
x-m-h2-09.s.s1.hint.0: Qiyaas garaafka f'(x)=3x²+2ax+b (parabola kor u furan). Si f u leeyahay extremum, calaamadda f' waa inay is beddesho.
x-m-h2-09.s.s1.hint.1: Ka fikir sida parabolakan ay tahay inay ku kulanto dhidibka x si f'(c)=0 laakiin calaamadda f' ay is beddelin.
x-m-h2-09.s.s1.ok.c2: f'(x)=3x²+2ax+b waa taabanayaa dhidibka x. Waxaa jira c oo f'(c)=0, laakiin calaamadda f' ma is beddesho.
x-m-h2-09.s.s1.fail.c2: Kala sooca 4a²−12b ee f'(x)=3x²+2ax+b ma aha 0. Haddii uu ka weyn yahay 0, calaamadda f' way is beddeshaa extremum-na wuu soo muuqdaa, haddii uu ka yar yahay 0 na c oo f'(c)=0 ma jiro.
x-m-h2-09.s.s1.explain: Haddii f'(x)=3x²+2ax+b uu taabanayo dhidibka x (kala sooca 4a²−12b=0, taasi waa, a²=3b), markaas f'(x)=3(x+a/3)²≥0, sidaas darteed xitaa haddii ay jirto bar f'=0, f way sii kordhaysaa. Tusaale ahaan, haddii a=0, b=0, markaas f(x)=x³ iyo f'(0)=0 laakiin extremum ma jiro.
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.prompt: Shaqooyinka aad samaysay kor, f'(c)=0 laakiin extremum ma jirin. Waa maxay shuruudda ugu habboon ee extremum lagu yeesho?
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.hint.0: Eeg calaamadda f'(x) ee shaqada aad samaysay tallaabadii hore, bidix iyo midig ee c.
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.hint.1: Barbar dhig macnaha extremum (ka beddelo kordhid ilaa hoos u dhac, iwm.) iyo doorasho kasta.
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.o.a: f'(c)=0 iyo calaamadda f' way is beddeshaa labada dhinac ee c
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.r.a: Waxaad tilmaantay in marka lagu daro f'(c)=0, shuruud ah kordhidda iyo hoos u dhaca in ay is beddelaan ay loo baahan yahay.
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.o.b: Inta f'(c)=0, had iyo jeer waa extremum calaamad kasta oo ay tahay
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.r.b: Tusaalihii hore ee aad samaysay (f(x)=x³ iwm.), f'(0)=0 laakiin extremum ma jirin.
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.o.c: f'(c)=0 iyo qiimaha shaqada f(c) sidoo kale waa inuu noqdaa 0
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.r.c: Qiimaha f(c) xiriir la ma laha haddii extremum jiro. f(x)=x³+1, f'(0)=0 iyo f(0)=1, laakiin extremum ma jiro.
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.o.d: f'(c) waa inuu ka weyn yahay 0
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.r.d: Haddii f'(c)>0, jeedalka xariiqda taabanaysa barta waa togan yahay, sidaas darteed shaqadu waa kordhaysaa. Ma aha musharax extremum.
x-m-h2-09.s.s2.explain: Si c u noqdo extremum, f'(c)=0 iyo calaamadda f' waa inay is beddelaan labada dhinac ee c (kordhid↔hoos u dhac). f'(c)=0 waa shuruud lagama maarmaan ah oo keliya in musharraxu noqdo extremum.

x-m-h2-02.title: Ma had iyo jeer awoodda 2 way ka weyn tahay labajibbaarka x?
x-m-h2-02.goal: Hel tusaale lid ku ah sheegashada ah in 2ˣ>x² had iyo jeer run tahay, oo go'aami sababta aad u odhan karto qiimaha laga bilaabo ay run tahay.
x-m-h2-02.material: Seojin wuxuu arkay in marka x=1, 2¹=2>1², marka x=5 na, 2⁵=32>5²=25, wuxuuna yiri, 'Tiro dhan oo togan x, 2ˣ had iyo jeer way ka weyn tahay x².' (2ˣ waa tirada aad hesho marka aad 2 ku dhufato naftiisa x jeer, x² na waa tirada aad hesho marka aad x ku dhufato laba jeer.)
x-m-h2-02.thinking.0: Naftaada u hel tusaale lid ku ah
x-m-h2-02.thinking.1: Kala saar hubinta dhowr xaaladood iyo sharaxaadda sababta
x-m-h2-02.thinking.2: Isbarbar dhig sida ay u kordhaan
x-m-h2-02.s.s1.prompt: Hel laba tiro dhan oo togan oo kala duwan x oo muujinaya in hadalka Seojin khalad yahay. (Taasi waa, x oo 2ˣ aanay ka weyn x², taasi waa, 2ˣ ≤ x².)
x-m-h2-02.s.s1.hint.0: Geli x=1, 2, 3, ... si kala horreysa oo qor qiimayaasha 2ˣ iyo x² dhinac-dhinac.
x-m-h2-02.s.s1.hint.1: Eeg qiimayaasha u dhexeeya x=1 iyo x=5 ee Seojin hubiyey.
x-m-h2-02.s.s1.ok.c1: x waa tiro dhan oo togan.
x-m-h2-02.s.s1.fail.c1: x waa inay noqotaa tiro dhan oo ugu yaraan 1.
x-m-h2-02.s.s1.ok.c2: 2ˣ ma ka weyna x² (tusaale lid ku ah).
x-m-h2-02.s.s1.fail.c2: x-kan, 2ˣ way ka weyn tahay x². Maaha qiime jebinaya hadalka Seojin.
x-m-h2-02.s.s1.explain: Haddii x=2, markaas 2²=4=2²; haddii x=3, markaas 2³=8<9=3²; haddii x=4, markaas 2⁴=16=4². Saddexdan waa tusaalayaal lid ku ah. Marka x=1 ama x=5, 2ˣ way ka weyn tahay.

x-m-h2-02.s.s2.o.a: Waxaan mid mid u xisaabiyey x=5 ilaa x=20 oo waxaan helay 2ˣ>x² mar kasta oo aan wax ka reeban jirin
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.r.a: Xataa haddii aad hubiso 20 xaaladood, ma ogaan kartid haddii qiimaha xiga uu run yahay. Hubinta dhowr xaaladood waa cadayn, ma aha sabab.
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.o.b: Marka x uu kordho 1, 2ˣ wuu laabmaa, x² na wuxuu kordhaa wax ka yar laba laab (x≥3 marka)
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.r.b: Tani waxay barbar dhigtaa intee ayay labada qiime kordhaan tallaabo kasta oo waxay helaysaa sababta farqigu u sii weynaado.
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.o.c: 2ˣ waa hawl tilmaame x² na waa hawl tibaax-badan, sidaa darteed 2ˣ way ka weyn tahay laga bilaabo 5
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.r.c: Waa run in hawl tilmaame ay ugu dambayn weynaato, laakiin bilowga kuma ahayn sidaas, sida x=3. Tani ma sharaxdo meesha laga bilaabo.
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.o.d: Haddii aad sawirto garaafyada, garaafka 2ˣ wuxuu ka sarreeyaa garaafka x²
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.r.d: Garaafku wuu caawiyaa qiyaasidda, laakiin meesha labada garaaf ay aad isugu dhow yihiin indhaha ayay adag tahay in la kala saaro, sababta na ma sharaxo.
x-m-h2-02.s.s2.explain: Marka x=5, 2⁵=32>25, marka x uu kordho 1 na 2ˣ wuu laabmaa halka x² uu noqdo (x+1)²/x² jeer, taasoo ka yar 2 marka x≥3. Sidaa darteed marka uu horyimaado, farqigu wuu sii weynaadaa. Hubinta dhowr qiime, nooca hawsha, ama qaabka garaafka keligood ma sharaxaan 'x kasta'.

x-m-h2-03.title: Ma sinθ=3/5 keligeed ayaa noo sheegi kartaa tanθ?
x-m-h2-03.goal: Naftaada u hel xaalad halkaas oo macluumaadka la bixiyey aanu go'aamin hal qiime, oo ka soo xulo macluumaadka loo baahan yahay si qiimaha loo go'aamiyo.
x-m-h2-03.material: Jihu wuxuu yiri kaliya 'xagal θ, sinθ=3/5' wuxuuna weydiiyey qiimaha tanθ. Daeun waxay tiri, 'Macluumaad ma ahan oo kaafi ah,' Hyunwoo na wuxuu yiri, 'Waa kaafi.' Sida loo akhriyo: sinθ waa sine theta, cosθ waa cosine theta, tanθ waa tangent theta, 3/5 na waa saddex shan-meelood.
x-m-h2-03.prereq.0: Qeexitaannada hawlaha saddex-xagalka iyo xiriirrada aasaasiga ah
x-m-h2-03.prereq.1: Halka xagal ku yaal marka loo eego rubuc
x-m-h2-03.s.s1.prompt: Marka uu jiro xagal θ oo leh sinθ=3/5, hel laba lammaane oo kala duwan oo qiimayaal suurtagal ah (cosθ, tanθ). (Geli cosθ=c iyo tanθ=t; waxaad qori kartaa jajab tobanle ah. tusaale, 3/5=0.6)
x-m-h2-03.s.s1.hint.0: Geli sinθ=0.6 sin²θ+cos²θ=1 oo qor waxa isla'egta cosθ noqoto.
x-m-h2-03.s.s1.hint.1: Tiri imisa qiime oo cosθ ayaa buuxiya isla'egtaas, oo mid walba u xisaabi tanθ=sinθ÷cosθ.
x-m-h2-03.s.s1.fail.c1: Ma ka dhigto sin²θ+cos²θ=1. Hubi waxa labajibbaarka cosθ ay tahay inuu noqdo marka sinθ=0.6.
x-m-h2-03.s.s1.fail.c2: tanθ ma la mid aha sinθ÷cosθ.
x-m-h2-03.s.s1.explain: Haddii sinθ=3/5, markaas cos²θ=16/25, sidaa darteed cosθ=4/5 ama −4/5. Haddii cosθ=0.8, tanθ=0.75, haddii cosθ=−0.8 na, tanθ=−0.75, sidaa darteed laba xaaladood ayaa suurtagal ah.
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.prompt: Haddii sidoo kale lagu siiyo mid ka mid ah kuwa soo socda sinθ=3/5 kaddib, qiimaha tanθ wuxuu noqonayaa hal. Dooro dhammaan macluumaadkaas oo kale.
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.hint.0: Hubi mid mid haddii labada kiis ee aad tallaabadii hore heshay mid kastaa buuxiyo shuruudda doorasho kasta.
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.hint.1: Kala saar doorashooyinka labada kiisba ay buuxiyaan shuruudda iyo kuwa hal kiis oo keliya ka hadho.
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.r.a: Xagal togan wuxuu ku jiri karaa afar-meel kasta. Hubi haddii labada kiis ee aad hore u samaysay ay hadhaan.
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.o.b: θ waa xagal ku jira afar-meelaha labaad
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.r.b: Shuruuddani waxay ka tagtaa mid ka mid ah labada kiis oo keliya. Eeg calaamadda cosθ afar-meelaha labaad.
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.o.c: θ waa xagal ku jira afar-meelaha koowaad ama labaad
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.r.c: Haddii sinθ=3/5>0, horeba waad taqaannaa tan, sidaas darteed ma aha macluumaad cusub. Labada kiis way hadhayaan.
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.r.d: Haddii sinθ>0 iyo tanθ<0, calaamadda cosθ waa go'an tahay. Hubi kee ka mid ah labada kiis ee hore ayaa hadha.
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.r.e: Baaxaddani waxay ka kooban tahay afar-meelaha koowaad iyo labaad labadaba, sidaas darteed labada kiis way hadhayaan.
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.r.f: Waxay kuu sheegaysaa calaamadda cosθ si toos ah, sidaas darteed hal kiis oo keliya ayaa hadha.
x-m-h2-03.s.s2.explain: Haddii sinθ=3/5, markaas cosθ=±4/5, sidaas darteed haddii aad ogtahay calaamadda cosθ, tanθ waa go'an yahay. Afar-meelaha labaad, tanθ<0 (cosθ<0 maadaama sinθ>0), iyo cosθ<0 dhammaantood waxay la macno yihiin cosθ<0, sidaas darteed tanθ=−3/4 waa go'an. Kuwa kale, kiiska cosθ>0 wuu hadhayaa, sidaas darteed waxaa jira laba qiime oo tanθ ah.
